about: Recurring grants, scholarships, fellowships and awards for students and early-career people, kept by hand. 'deadline' is a confirmed upcoming date; when the next round is not announced, 'expected' gives the usual timing and 'check' is true. Past deadlines move to the 'not announced yet' list by themselves.

items.name: AAPG Foundation Grants-in-Aid
items.note: Graduate research grants in the geosciences. Two endorsements are due by 21 December 2026. One listing says the program may pause, so confirm before applying.

items.name: GSA Graduate Student Research Grants
items.note: Research support for master's and PhD students who are GSA members.

items.name: Sigma Xi Grants in Aid of Research
items.org: Sigma Xi, The Scientific Research Honor Society
items.note: Small research grants for undergraduate and graduate students in any science.
items.cycle: Twice a year: 15 March and 1 October

items.name: SEG Scholarships
items.note: For high-school seniors and college students planning a career in applied geophysics. One application covers every SEG scholarship you qualify for; the window opened 1 November 2026.

items.name: AGU Horton Research Grant
items.expected: Usually open early January to mid-March
items.note: For PhD students in hydrology, water resources or a closely related field who are AGU student members; up to three grants a year.

items.name: NOAA Hollings Undergraduate Scholarship
items.note: Two years of academic support plus a paid summer internship at NOAA, for undergraduates in NOAA-related sciences.

items.name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship (GRFP)
items.expected: October 2027 (this year's geosciences deadline was 23 October 2026)
items.note: Three years of support for early graduate students; the FY2027 round expects about 1,500 awards.

items.name: DOE Office of Science Graduate Student Research (SCGSR)
items.expected: About May 2027 (the latest round closed 4 November 2026)
items.note: PhD students spend 3 to 12 months doing thesis research at a DOE national laboratory.

items.name: NASA FINESST (Future Investigators in NASA Earth and Space Science)
items.expected: With NASA's next research call (ROSES-27, planned for early 2027); the last round closed 14 July 2026
items.note: Graduate student research projects in Earth and space science, proposed with an adviser.

items.name: NASA Postdoctoral Program (NPP)
items.note: Postdoctoral fellowships at NASA centers, within five years of the PhD; senior fellowships for others. NASA has shifted round dates recently.
items.cycle: Three rounds a year: 1 March, 1 July, 1 November

items.name: NSF Earth Sciences Postdoctoral Fellowships (EAR-PF)
items.expected: No 2027 call yet; the last solicitation (NSF 25-500) is archived
items.note: Two-year fellowships for early-career Earth scientists. Past deadlines fell in late October or early November.

items.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships
items.note: Fellowships at European host institutions for researchers of any nationality with up to eight years of postdoctoral experience.

items.name: CUAHSI Pathfinder Fellowship
items.org: Consortium of Universities for the Advancement of Hydrologic Science
items.expected: Varies: autumn or early in the year (2025: 7 February)
items.note: Lets graduate students at U.S. universities add a new site, method or collaborator to their hydrology research.

items.name: NSF CAREER (Faculty Early Career Development)
items.note: For untenured assistant professors (or equivalent) who integrate research and education; the deadline is the fourth Wednesday of July.

items.name: AGU Medals, Awards, Prizes and Fellows (nominations)
items.expected: Early March 2027 (2026: medals 2 March, fellows and section awards 13 March)
items.note: Nominate a colleague or student for AGU's union medals, early-career awards and fellowship.
